subject: Follow-up: Clarion MAP checkpoint missed — propose next steps & demo
messages:
From: Sylvia Park <sylvia@clarionhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Holloway <jake@clarionhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — quick sync today?

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the invite — I joined the calendar link a few minutes early but then had to step into an urgent vendor call. I didn't see anyone in the meeting after I returned, so I assume something came up on your side. Apologies for the back-and-forth; we've also had a snag with our procurement team needing an extra week for contract review.

Can we rebook the MAP checkpoint next week? Best windows for us are Tue/Wed mornings PT. We'd also like to review the integration checklist and ask a few SOC2-related questions (team will include our security lead, Jake).

Appreciate the flexibility — let me know what works.

Best,
Sylvia Park\Director of Clinical Systems\Clarion Health

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Park <sylvia@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 16:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — quick sync today?

Hi Sylvia — thanks for the note and sorry for the confusion on our side. We had a late staffing issue and the meeting didn't get covered. My apologies for the no-show.

I've attached an updated Mutual Action Plan that reflects a one-week slip to accommodate procurement timing and the security review. Key changes:
- Procurement milestone moved to Aug 24 (previously Aug 17)
- Security questionnaire deliverable expanded to include SOC2 artifact list
- Added a clear owner for the test integration (Monica) and a fallback demo scope if procurement needs a phased start

Attachments: Clarion_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet) — short summary on the first sheet.

Proposed reschedule slots (PT):
- Tue Aug 11, 9:00–9:45am
- Tue Aug 11, 10:30–11:15am
- Wed Aug 12, 9:00–9:45am

If those don't work, tell us two windows that do and we'll lock it in. Monica will cover the integration checklist and Stephanie will be on the SOC2 Q&A.

Thanks — we want to keep momentum but make this low friction for your procurement/security teams.

Best regards,
Aditya Rao\Account Executive | Redwood Inference\aditya_rao@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference for production

From: Jake Holloway <jake@clarionhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sylvia Park <sylvia@clarionhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — quick sync today?

Thanks Aditya — Tue the 11th at 10:30 PT works for us. Sylvia, looping in our security lead as discussed; I pulled the SOC2 items we need covered and attached a short list.

Also: procurement flagged two questions about data residency for logging and retention windows — can someone from Redwood confirm whether logs for the dedicated deployment live in-region and how retention is configured by default? If not in the meeting, a short doc/email would help our procurement review.

Jake Holloway\Senior IT Security Manager\Clarion Health
(attached: clarion_soc2_questions.pdf)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jake Holloway <jake@clarionhealth.com>, Sylvia Park <sylvia@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — quick sync today?

Great — confirmed: Tue Aug 11, 10:30–11:15am PT. Calendar invite coming shortly with the updated agenda and a short demo of the private deployment topology.

Quick answers to Jake's procurement questions (summary; Monica and Stephanie will add detail in the meeting):
- Logs: For a Dedicated/Private deployment, logs can be kept in-region under customer-controlled storage (we support customer KMS for keys).
- Retention: Default retention is 90 days in the managed hosted offering but is configurable for Dedicated/Private; we can match longer retention in contract/commit terms.

I've also uploaded a recording from today's missed demo (demo-recording-2026-08-09.mp4) and a short pricing brief for your procurement team (redwood-pricing-brief.pdf). These are on the shared MAP link so you can review asynchronously: https://drive.redwood.com/s/clarion/map-v2

Agenda for Tue:
1) 10m — Alignment on procurement cadence and outstanding questions
2) 15m — Integration checklist and required artifacts (Monica)
3) 15m — Security & SOC2 Q&A (Stephanie)
4) 15m — Short demo of private topology + next steps

If there's anything else to add to the agenda, reply-all and we'll slot it. Looking forward to getting this back on track.

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Sylvia Park <sylvia@clarionhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Holloway <jake@clarionhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — quick sync today?

Thanks — invite received and accepted. I've asked procurement to review the pricing brief pre-meeting; Jake will bring the SOC2 list. We appreciate the recording and updated MAP — that should help our execs see progress even with the shifted timeline.

See you at 10:30 PT.

Best,
Sylvia
